import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_two_field_loss_b()
    return nothing
end

function two_field_loss_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, p, pb, q, qb, i_n)
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        p[i_x] = u[i_x] ^ 2
    end
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        q[i_x] = v[i_x] ^ 3
    end
    for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + p[i_seq_x] + q[i_seq_x]
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
        pb[i_seq_x] = pb[i_seq_x] + lossb[1]
        qb[i_seq_x] = qb[i_seq_x] + lossb[1]
    end
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + (3 * v[i_x] ^ 2) * qb[i_x]
        qb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + (2 * u[i_x]) * pb[i_x]
        pb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_two_field_loss_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function two_field_loss_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, p, pb, q, qb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_1!(i_n, p, u)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_2!(i_n, q, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_3!(i_n, loss, p, q)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_4!(i_n, lossb, pb, qb)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_5!(i_n, qb, v, vb)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_6!(i_n, pb, u, ub)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_1!(i_n, p, u)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    p[i_x] = u[i_x] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_2!(i_n, q, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    q[i_x] = v[i_x] ^ 3
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_3!(i_n, loss, p, q)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += p[i_seq_x] + q[i_seq_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_4!(i_n, lossb, pb, qb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    pb[i_seq_x] = pb[i_seq_x] + lossb[1]
    qb[i_seq_x] = qb[i_seq_x] + lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_5!(i_n, qb, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + (3 * v[i_x] ^ 2) * qb[i_x]
    qb[i_x] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_two_field_loss_b_6!(i_n, pb, u, ub)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + (2 * u[i_x]) * pb[i_x]
    pb[i_x] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 2

__base_u = Float64[-0.9381592246195162, 0.9605577253836316, -0.47508000898503394, 0.4926411976468955]

__seed_u = [Float64[-0.6688317730895812, 1.047855750706515, -0.872754275848158, -0.3657455356291479], Float64[0.7164804802261496, 0.10463631400113019, 0.2706743540239487, -2.0495056565830616]]
__seed_v = [Float64[0.8600156041467961, 0.9117629321018853, 2.5146803079595856, -0.044240230770544654], Float64[-0.21612424170443403, 0.5868619524327767, 1.615177475316104, -0.7512441778090275]]
__seed_p = [Float64[0.029161906832359856, -0.6993758857556043, -0.8044837660944691, -1.4021323952100833], Float64[0.03165888854320513, -0.4830720744400909, 1.8354537215331599, -0.3625923588676318]]
__seed_q = [Float64[0.04293500974458512, -1.1252492342931184, -0.3560862775023554, -0.855800013341105], Float64[0.3282073923226976, 0.5781917618489347, -0.05759522908651797, -1.3824960023372812]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:2
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  v_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_v); v_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial])
  v_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_v)); v_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial]))
  p_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_p); p_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_p[__trial])
  p_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_p)); p_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_p[__trial]))
  q_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_q); q_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_q[__trial])
  q_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_q)); q_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_q[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_two_field_loss_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_two_field_loss_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = two_field_loss_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, v_val_cpu, v_sh_cpu, p_val_cpu, p_sh_cpu, q_val_cpu, q_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = two_field_loss_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, v_val_gpu, v_sh_gpu, p_val_gpu, p_sh_gpu, q_val_gpu, q_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_sh_cpu, Array(v_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_val_cpu, Array(v_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(p_sh_cpu, Array(p_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(p_val_cpu, Array(p_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(q_sh_cpu, Array(q_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(q_val_cpu, Array(q_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
